006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.net.URI;
009import java.net.URISyntaxException;
010import java.util.List;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.CastFunctionException;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IQNameItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
022import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
023import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025
026/**
027 * /** Implements
028 * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-QName">fn:QName</a>
029 * functions.
030 */
031public final class FnQName {
032  @NonNull
033  private static final String NAME = "QName";
034
035  @NonNull
036  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
037      .name(NAME)
038      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
039      .deterministic()
040      .contextIndependent()
041      .focusIndependent()
042      .argument(IArgument.builder()
043          .name("paramURI")
044          .type(IStringItem.type())
045          .zeroOrOne()
046          .build())
047      .argument(IArgument.builder()
048          .name("paramQName")
049          .type(IStringItem.type())
050          .one()
051          .build())
052      .returnType(IQNameItem.type())
053      .returnOne()
054      .functionHandler(FnQName::execute)
055      .build();
056
057  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
058  @NonNull
059  private static ISequence<IQNameItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
060      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
061      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
062      IItem focus) {
063    IStringItem paramUri = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
064    IStringItem paramQName = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
065
066    IEnhancedQName result;
067    if (paramUri == null) {
068      result = IEnhancedQName.of(paramQName.asString());
069    } else {
070      if (paramUri.length() == 0) {
071        throw new CastFunctionException(
072            CastFunctionException.INVALID_LEXICAL_VALUE,
073            paramUri,
074            String.format("paramURI is an empty string and not a valid URI to form a QName."));
075      }
076
077      URI uri;
078      try {
079        uri = ObjectUtils.notNull(new URI(paramUri.asString()));
080      } catch (URISyntaxException ex) {
081        throw new CastFunctionException(
082            CastFunctionException.INVALID_LEXICAL_VALUE,
083            paramUri,
084            String.format("paramURI '%s' is not a valid URI to form a QName.", paramUri.asString()),
085            ex);
086      }
087      result = IEnhancedQName.of(uri, paramQName.asString());
088    }
089    return ISequence.of(IQNameItem.valueOf(result));
090  }
091
092  private FnQName() {
093    // disable construction
094  }
095}
